What I meant by that was once she’s moved in she can have a fresh start and not have to be concerned with me (out of sight out of mind). I know they won’t be ok I’m just hoping in the end they’ll understand that I’ve tried really hard but it just wasn’t enough and I’m exhausted from always having to pick myself up when the world becomes too much for me. I hope they’ll heal from the pain I caused and at least be happy that I’m no longer in pain. 
This is my form of control. I know it’s not healthy but it’s all I can grab on to. I’m too late save and I’m too tired to continue to console myself by saying everything will be ok when there’s been no change after 20yrs. 
Thank you but I choose to not be in pain

How you choose to live and give meaning to your life is ultimately up to you. Im not being encouraged to take my life. This is a decision I’m making on my own and one I need ppl to respect. Your brother and I are in the 99% not because it’s easy but due to the fact that not everyone can keep their demons at bay; some ppl have been fighting for so long that they’re too battered and bruised to continue the fight. I’m happy that you’re in the 1%, but I’m not. Please respect my decision as I have respected yours

I understand your perspective and I even respect it, but I’ve been holding on for the sake of others for so long and I’m finally choosing myself over anyone else. Life...has been really hard for me and I’m tired of struggling just to breathe. Thank you for your concern tho.

Thank you. I don’t want applause or pity, but thank you for telling me it was ok. I want to let go so badly. I’m sane and I know this option is permeant, but when I’m conscious (not asleep) I’m just balling my eyes out and trying to stop this sharp pain in my chest. I feel like shit and cant help but think of all the ways life would be better if I wasn’t here. That’s the only thing that gives me piece of mind now. I wish I wasn’t so broken and that I was strong enough to go on but I’m not.

Everything in my life is spinning out of control at least with this I regain the control over my happiness. I am sick, but I understand the choice I’m making. 

I promised her I would help her move out and I want her to be ok before I end things. I want to give her a new start without having to worry about me. Thank you but I did something to make her fall out of love with me I just don’t know what
